ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In order to maximize efficiency and prevent blood backflow, the flow of blood through the heart must be carefully organized. As shown in the figure below, venous blood enters the heart through chamber 1, passes in sequence through the right atrium and right ventricle, and then flows to the lungs through the pulmonary artery. After being oxygenated through the lungs, arterial blood returns through the pulmonary vein, enters the left atrium and left ventricle, and finally leaves the heart through the aorta. The contraction of the heart is triggered by action potentials propagated by cardiac muscle cells. If the amount of blood in chamber 3 (right ventricle) suddenly increases, the action potentials of which heart chamber will increase?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, label 3 is located on the lower left side of the heart (anatomical right side), corresponding to the right ventricle; the adjacent label 2 above it corresponds to the right atrium. Label 1 is the pathway by which venous blood enters the heart, and the blood passes in sequence through the right atrium and right ventricle as stated in the prompt. Then reason: If the amount of blood in chamber 3, the right ventricle, suddenly increases, this indicates that the demand for filling and pushing from the right atrium to the right ventricle increases; to enhance this input, the heart chamber whose action potentials most directly need to increase is the right atrium. Enhanced pacemaking activity of the right atrium will also drive an increase in subsequent right ventricular filling. Final answer: Right atrium.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中各编号关系：确认3号腔室是右心室，右心室上游相邻腔室是右心房（图中通常为2号）。再读取题干给出的流向：静脉血进入心脏后依次经过右心房、右心室，再去肺部；收缩由动作电位触发。若3号右心室内血液量突然增加，沿正常充盈路径追溯其来源，应是右心房向右心室输入更多血液，因此需要增加动作电位、增强收缩的是右心房。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中标号3位于心脏下部左侧（解剖学右侧），对应右心室；其上方相邻的标号2对应右心房。标号1为静脉血进入心脏的通路，血液按题干所述依次经过右心房和右心室。再推理：如果3号腔室右心室内血液量突然增加，说明右心房向右心室的充盈和推动需求增加；要增强这种输入，最直接需要增加动作电位的心腔就是右心房。右心房的起搏活动增强，也会带动后续右心室充盈增加。最终答案：Right atrium。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the cardiac flow/conduction bridge: atrial action potentials trigger atrial contraction, and atrial contraction fills the corresponding ventricle before ventricular ejection. Therefore, if right-ventricular blood volume is increased through normal forward flow, the upstream chamber whose electrical activity/contraction would increase is the right atrium.
